source_title: Samsung News is shutting down: How to switch to Google Discover

After a long journey spanning nearly a decade and three design overhauls, Samsung's news aggregator app is shutting down . Thankfully, Galaxy phone and tablet users who want quick access to aggregated news via their home screens still have an option: Google Discover.
Galaxy device users have had to choose between Samsung News and Google Discover — or not using a news aggregator at all — for years. With Samsung discontinuing its service, that choice has become clearer.

In its termination notice, Samsung even kindly recommends removing News widgets from your Home screen. If you have one, you can delete it by holding it and tapping Remove all .
So far, Samsung has sent discontinuation notices in a couple of markets, including India and South Korea. In those regions, Samsung News will be shutting down on December 21, 2026. Presumably, Samsung will pull the plug on the news aggregator globally on the same date or shortly after.
Samsung News has had an eventful journey spanning nearly a decade. It began as Bixby Home in 2017 and was transformed into Samsung Daily a couple of years later.
Then, at the end of 2020, Samsung Daily became Samsung Free . However, the third time wasn't the charm. Due to subpar performance, Samsung gave the platform another shot three years later . It became what Galaxy phone and tablet users know today as Samsung News.
Samsung hasn't said why the News platform will be shutting down, but with AI changing the web search landscape as dramatically as it has, the decision doesn't come as a complete surprise.
